database_notes.scope: 500 additional common ingredient-label terms; not 500 branded food products.
database_notes.verification: Ingredient names and allergen groupings were cross-checked against official FDA, UK Food Standards Agency, and European Commission food-additive/allergen references. Individual manufacturer formulations and certification were not verified.
database_notes.important_limit: This is an ingredient screening aid, not a halal/kosher certification, medical allergy guarantee, or substitute for reading the full package label. Composite foods and ambiguous derivatives require manufacturer confirmation.
database_notes.hindu_profile: Preserves the original app rule: the Hindu profile screens for beef only; it is not a statement about every Hindu person's dietary practice.
database_notes.sulphites_note: UK/EU allergen declaration thresholds and exemptions depend on the applicable jurisdiction; sulphites are commonly subject to declaration above 10 mg/kg or 10 mg/L.
